::: {.callout-note}
DSC-based machine state enforcement across organizational tiers — Tier 0 substrate, Tier 1 production, and Tier 2 standard baselines authored as PowerShell DSC, compiled to Guest Configuration packages, deployed through Azure Policy, and targeted at Arc-connected machines by OrgTier tag. Companion to the [Old AD vs New EntraID foundational reference](../learning/old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Authoritative canon"}
The substrate-internal canonical specification for OrgPath-driven Azure
Policy targeting is [UIAO_010 — OrgPath in Azure Policy](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/UIAO_010_OrgPath_in_Azure_Policy.md),
which wraps [ADR-039](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/adr/adr-039-policy-targeting.md)
plus `canon/data/orgpath/policy-targets.yaml` (retired by [ADR-078](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/adr/adr-078-orgpath-attribute-schema-15-facet.md) Phase 1; per-facet rebuild scheduled in Phase 5).
The Guest Configuration patterns in this chapter sit *below* that
targeting layer — Azure Policy assignments deliver Guest Configuration
packages to Arc machines whose `OrgPath` ARM tag matches the canonical
selector. This chapter is the customer-facing narrative; the canon doc
is the operator/spec reference.
:::
